title: Waivers No More
summary:
decides not to renew Iranian export waivers
On Monday April 22, the U.S. announced that it will not extend the sanctions waivers when they expire on May 2 nd . The stated objective of the Trump administration is to force Iranian crude oil and condensate exports to zero.
